_comment: Foreground/background pairs that must keep a minimum WCAG 2.x contrast ratio. Names are --nivora-* semantic roles from src/nivora/theme/nivora-tokens.inc.css (without the leading dashes). 'min' is 4.5 for text (AA), 3.0 for the boundary of an interactive control or a focus indicator (WCAG 1.4.11).

pairs.note: boundary of an interactive control, WCAG 1.4.11
